title: Add server-side pagination to the detection rules table
description:
Rules table now requests pages of 20 rules from the API instead of loading all rules.
Acceptance criteria:
- Table shows 20 rules per page with next/previous controls
- Changing the sort column resets to page 1
- Bulk-select only selects rules on the current page

files.patch: + const { data } = useFindRules({ page, perPage: 20, sortField });
